target: fork diff vs upstream (23 files: 14 Rust + scripts + ftl)

confirmed.claim: Extension translation worker threads write results by Vec index captured at spawn time, while take_finished_translations drains (removes) finished records from the same Vec every frame. After a drain shifts the list, a stale index write either (a) lands out of bounds and is silently dropped, leaving the record outcome=None forever so it is never drained and permanently consumes the 8-slot cap, blocking all future extension translations, or (b) overwrites a DIFFERENT request's record, delivering the wrong translation to the wrong plugin action.
confirmed.fix: Records now carry a unique id (AtomicU64); the worker calls complete_pending(id, result) which locates the record by id. Stale ids are no-ops. Regression test complete_pending_targets_the_record_by_id_not_position covers drain-then-stale-complete and matching-id completion.

confirmed.claim: auto_incoming marks a message as auto-requested only when spawn_inline returns true. For skip-classified content (links/emoji/credentials) spawn_inline returns false, so every visible skipped message is re-classified on every frame for the whole session.
confirmed.fix: auto_incoming now marks skipped messages as requested too (an edit still clears the mark via clear_inline), so classification runs once per message.

dismissed.claim: queue_send returns SendOutcome::Busy for empty text, which reads oddly for future callers.
dismissed.reason: Unreachable in practice: the only caller guards !draft_text.trim().is_empty() before invoking. Noted as a comment-level concern, not a behavior bug.
